reviewedBy: Dr. K. M. Rahman (Poultry Disease Specialist, DVM, MS)
disclaimer: Commercial egg layers require precision lighting schedules, calcium balance, and Egg Drop Syndrome (EDS) vaccination. Consult your veterinary flock supervisor.

stages.name: Brooding
stages.feed: Layer Chick Starter Mash (20-21% crude protein)
tips: Brooding uniformity during weeks 1-4 dictates lifetime peak egg lay.
Gradually decrease brooding temperature 0.5°C daily from 35°C down to 24°C by day 28.
Clean drinkers daily and maintain dry litter bedding.

milestones.title: Hatchery Marek's Disease (HVT) Vaccination Audit
milestones.instructions: Verify hatchery Marek's HVT injection certificate and inspect day-old pullet chick vigor.

milestones.title: Newcastle Disease + Infectious Bronchitis (ND+IB) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop of combined ND+IB live vaccine in one eye. Ensure complete absorption.

milestones.title: Infectious Bursal Disease (Gumboro) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop of intermediate plus strain in eye.

milestones.title: Newcastle Disease (ND LaSota) Booster Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer live ND LaSota eye-drop to booster systemic mucosal immunity.

milestones.title: Day 28 Pullet Weighing & Frame Growth Check
milestones.instructions: Weigh 5% of flock (target: 280-320g). Target 85%+ flock uniformity.

stages.name: Grower
tips: Focus on skeletal and shank development; avoid excessive body fat.
Keep natural or artificial lighting constant (8-10 hours) to prevent premature sexual maturity.
Ensure perches and feeder access are ample.

milestones.title: Precision Infrared Beak Conditioning / Trimming Audit
milestones.instructions: Audit pullet beak uniformity to prevent feather pecking and egg cannibalism. Supplement Vitamin K in water for 48 hours.

milestones.title: Fowl Pox Wing-Web Inoculation
milestones.instructions: Administer Fowl Pox vaccine via wing-web puncture. Check scab take at day 50.

milestones.title: Inactivated ND + IB Killed Vaccine Intramuscular Injection
milestones.instructions: Inject 0.5 ml inactivated oil-adjuvant ND+IB vaccine into breast muscle or thigh using sterile 18G needle.

milestones.title: Day 70 Pullet Body Weight Benchmark
milestones.instructions: Weigh sample pullets (target: 650-750g). Confirm skeletal shank length.

stages.name: Developer & Pre-Lay
stages.feed: Developer & Pre-Lay Mash (15-16% crude protein, 2.5% Ca)
tips: Increase calcium in feed around week 16-17 to develop medullary bone reserves for future eggshells.
Commence photostimulation: increase light duration by 30-60 minutes weekly towards a 16-hour day.
Transfer pullets to layer cages or deep litter laying quarters by Day 120-126.

milestones.title: Pre-Lay Broad-Spectrum Deworming
milestones.instructions: Administer veterinary approved dewormer in morning water to clear internal parasite burden before laying onset.

milestones.title: ND + EDS (Egg Drop Syndrome) + IB Triple Killed Injection
milestones.instructions: Inject 0.5 ml triple killed emulsion intramuscularly. Protects lay against catastrophic egg drop syndrome.

milestones.title: Laying Quarters Transfer & Pre-Lay Weighing
milestones.instructions: Weigh pullets (target: 1.35-1.50 kg). Ensure nests and automatic nipple lines are sanitized.

stages.name: Production & Laying
stages.feed: Layer Phase-1 Mash (17% crude protein, 3.8-4.2% Ca)
tips: Maintain strict 16 hours light / 8 hours darkness schedule every single day.
Provide coarse limestone or oyster shell grit in the late afternoon to support overnight calcification.
Collect eggs at least 3-4 times daily to prevent cracking and nest soiling.
Record daily egg production and calculate hen-day egg percentage (HDP).

milestones.title: Onset of Lay (5% Flock Production Milestone)
milestones.instructions: Record date of first egg. Transition feed fully to high-calcium Layer Phase-1 formulation.

milestones.title: Peak Lay Audit (Target 90%+ Hen-Day Production)
milestones.instructions: Audit daily egg trays against live hen count. Check average egg weight (target: 58-62g) and shell hardness.

milestones.title: Mid-Cycle Layer Health & Egg Shell Quality Audit
milestones.instructions: Check egg breaking strength and shell thickness. Supplement Vitamin D3 and organic minerals if necessary.

milestones.title: 52-Week Layer Production Cycle Audit & Batch Close
milestones.instructions: Summarize total lifetime eggs produced, total feed consumed, cumulative mortality, and calculate final flock profit.
